16.  圖中，半圓 $ABC$ 的直徑為 $3\text{ cm}$。若 $AC = 2\text{ cm}$，求陰影區域的面積準確至最接近的 $0.01\text{ cm}^2$。

A. $0.23\text{ cm}^2$
B. $0.52\text{ cm}^2$
C. $0.64\text{ cm}^2$
D. $1.07\text{ cm}^2$
reasoning:
The radius of the semicircle is $r = 1.5\text{ cm}$. Let $O$ be the center. Triangle $OAC$ is an isosceles triangle with sides $OA = OC = 1.5\text{ cm}$ and $AC = 2\text{ cm}$. Using the Law of Cosines to find the central angle $\angle AOC = \theta$: $2^2 = 1.5^2 + 1.5^2 - 2(1.5)(1.5)\cos\theta$, which gives $\cos\theta = 1/9$, so $\theta \approx 1.4595$ radians. 
Area of sector $OAC = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}(1.5)^2(1.4595) \approx 1.6419\text{ cm}^2$.
Area of triangle $OAC = \frac{1}{2}r^2\sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}(1.5)^2\sqrt{1-(1/9)^2} \approx 1.1180\text{ cm}^2$.
Area of the shaded segment = Sector Area - Triangle Area $\approx 1.6419 - 1.1180 = 0.5239\text{ cm}^2$.
Rounding to the nearest $0.01\text{ cm}^2$ gives $0.52\text{ cm}^2$.
